# TinyPS

> TinyPS is a local-first image editor available as a Chrome and Edge browser extension. It compresses, resizes, crops, adds text, removes backgrounds with on-device AI, and converts images (JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, GIF) entirely inside your browser — image files are never uploaded to any server.

TinyPS is a free, privacy-focused image editing tool that runs 100% on-device. Unlike online editors, it has no backend upload: every operation happens locally in the browser via a browser extension. It is designed for users who need fast, private image editing without signing up or sending photos to a third party. Works offline after installation, on both Chrome and Edge (Manifest V3).

## Key facts
- Processing location: 100% local / on-device, no upload, no cloud
- Platforms: Chrome and Edge browser extensions (Manifest V3)
- Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, GIF
- Features: compress, resize, crop, fill/canvas, add text, remove background (on-device AI), format conversion, GIF frame-by-frame editing (up to 60 frames, export animated GIF), one-click batch processing (replay recorded text and fill-layer edits on all pages), fine rotation adjustment (1-degree steps or 0-359 degrees, non-destructive on selected layers)
- Account: none required, no sign-up, no login
- Offline: works without an internet connection after install
- Pricing: free core, optional Pro (every Pro feature has a free 3-day trial, no credit card)
- GIF editing: yes — split an animated GIF into editable frames, edit each frame, export a real animated GIF, 100% local
- Batch processing: yes — open many images as pages, apply the same edits, one-click replay of layer operations, export as one ZIP
